title: Sway Syde - Night Rider
htmlContent:
Sway Syde shares a new single called "Night Rider". The track "Night Rider" is a hip hop track that encompasses the thrill, experience and excitement of driving a car at high speeds used as a "metaphor" for the performers actual real life.

Sway Syde’s “Night Rider” is a super record with a digestible sound anyone who listens can enjoy. His star presence is undeniable and carries this song to it’s rightful destination, with a sound full of appeal that shines brighter with every listen. Sway sounds like the next big star, and he has the music to back it up with this amazing piece of audio.
